text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for gathering here
today,
everyone. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Without further ado, let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the magnificent Ball Royale,
where
fearless princesses dance and do
battle!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if I'm up against the older

students—I'm going to be number one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The whole princess thing doesn't suit
me, but I
won't lose when it comes to
running!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful to receive an invitation
unrelated
to official business! I can't wait
to take all sorts of
photos. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone. The first dance will
begin in
ten minutes. Please complete
your preparations
by then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the "Ball Royale"
Kawakami Princess has been planning for
a while. She told
me about the event
some time before, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this, Trainer! I'm thinking of
holding a
Ball Royale. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It'll be just like the event that Princess
Fighter
attended in the original series!
My excitement's
through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And just you wait! I'm going to prove
that I'm the
most dazzling princess of
them all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though it sounds like an elegant dance
party, Kawakami Princess's level of
enthusiasm suggests there's more to it,
so I come along to check up on the
event myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you're here, Trainer! What
perfect
timing—we're just about to start
running!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's a heated competition
where
racers give it their all as they
strive to claim
victory!
choice_data_list: So the 'ball' was actually a race!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy that you came to watch! To
tell the
truth, you're acting just like the
prince from
Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Also known as Legendary Trainer, he
supported
the princess when she
participated in her own Ball
Royale!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With your support and with my signature

racewear—my "dress"—I'm at my
absolute
strongest today!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's right! A dress is the formal attire
of a
fighting princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Every single fiber of this signature
racewear dress
is packed full of my
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This powerful pink represents blazing
fighting
spirit mixed with glittering
purity.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And the diamonds represent
unbreakable will!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This design isn't based on who I am right
now, but rather who I want to be. I want
to become
someone who won't put this
dress to shame.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Being a princess means having the
resolve to never quit on the path to
becoming stronger and
more dazzling
than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I think so too. ♪
choice_data_list: That dress looks great on you.
Let's show them how a princess runs!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I had it tailored specifically to suit not
the me of yesterday, not even the me of
today, but the me I
plan to become
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please watch me out there, Trainer! I'll
show you a
performance worthy of this
dress!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, please take your
places!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, let us create some wonderful
memories. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Raaarrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ack, she's fast!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In this dress, I'm going to shine brighter
and be
more princess-like than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
AW YEAH! I smashed it! Like a bold and
gallant
princess should!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, I was so close! Kawakami, I
demand a
rematch! Next time, I'll be
number one for sure!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gladly! A princess never backs down
from a
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After achieving a brilliant victory in the
race,
Kawakami Princess seems to glow
with triumphant
radiance.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Naturally! I'm going to smash this race!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, please take your
places!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I just have to run with everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm... number ooone!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow! Everyone is so fast! But...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Grr... Gaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Just... a little... furtheeeer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nghhhh, I can't believe this! I was
supposed to be
the princess who wins!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, you're completely right. It would
be
laughable for a princess to lose heart
over such a
small setback!
choice_data_list: A princess never gives up—on to th...
A princess doesn't give up—on to t...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I have you by my side, Trainer. I
need to
attack my training with grit and
determination.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll be the belle of the next Ball
Royale!
